rows.title: real Chrome binary replaces the old shell; headless is the default mode
rows.evidence: test asserts the launched binary path matches the pinned Chrome for Testing 158 manifest, not chrome-headless-shell 155, and that omitting a mode starts headless with no platform window

rows.title: private-desktop mode: headed Chrome on a desktop the owner never sees
rows.evidence: test asserts a headed Chrome window exists only on the hidden desktop and foreground, cursor and clipboard fields are unchanged across navigate, click and capture while the image is non-blank

rows.title: browser_assert: DOM, AX, text, URL and network assertions with bounded polling
rows.evidence: test asserts each check returns expected, observed and verdict fields, and a check still false past the poll budget returns verdict false with the last observed value rather than a timeout

rows.title: network route, mock, abort, offline and restore on cancel, timeout and EOF
rows.evidence: test asserts a routed request returns the mock body, abort yields a typed failure, offline blocks navigation, and after cancel, timeout and EOF the route is removed and a later unrouted request reaches the origin

rows.title: deterministic clock, locale, timezone, permissions and animation freeze
rows.evidence: test asserts Date.now, Intl locale and timezone in the page match the pinned values and a programmatically granted permission is readable in the page with no prompt

rows.title: browser_download: caller directory, accept, timeout, maxBytes, SHA-256, MIME and cleanup
rows.evidence: test asserts the file lands in the caller directory with the expected SHA-256 and MIME, a cancelled or over-maxBytes download leaves no partial file, and the temp directory is empty after cleanup

rows.title: browser_trace: HAR, screenshots, redaction, retention and cleanup
rows.evidence: test asserts the trace directory holds a HAR whose recorded URLs are redacted plus screenshots, and that retention expiry and cleanup remove the directory

rows.title: browser_audit: six viewports, contrast, typography, focus ring, target size, overflow and aria-snapshot match
rows.evidence: test asserts an audit at 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 2560 px returns one evidence record per check, and a failing contrast check names the measured ratio

rows.title: storage state export and import plus auth setup
rows.evidence: test asserts an exported storage state imported into a fresh context restores the authenticated session and a named tab identity stays stable across calls

rows.title: frame-scoped layout, assert_layout and visual
rows.evidence: test asserts layout, assert_layout and visual accept the same frame= contract as snapshot and click, and a ref inside a named frame resolves only in that frame

rows.title: native DataTransfer drag with trusted dragstart and drop
rows.evidence: test asserts the page handler sees isTrusted true on both dragstart and drop and the dropped payload matches the source element

rows.title: ordered form batches with per-step failure and final verdict
rows.evidence: test asserts a four-step batch reports ok per step, a failing middle step is named with its typed error, later steps still run, and the final verdict is fail

rows.title: navigation observed: status, redirects, timings
rows.evidence: test asserts navigate returns a versioned observed object with status, the redirect chain and timing fields while the legacy url and title fields keep their current values

rows.title: 30-task loopback suite, one command, three consecutive clean runs
rows.test: fixtures/run-tasks.mjs::node fixtures/run-tasks.mjs --repeat 3 exits 0 with all 30 tasks passing
rows.evidence: test asserts one command runs all 30 tasks and three consecutive runs finish with zero failures and zero flakes

rows.title: hidden desktop as the headline: Win32, WPF and WinUI3 fixtures with teardown proof
rows.evidence: test asserts each of the three fixture families launches on a hidden desktop and that after close the desktop has no windows and the job object is gone

rows.title: publish the import-table proof in the README and every screenshot result
rows.evidence: test asserts the running binary's PE import table has no SetCursorPos, SendInput or SetForegroundWindow call and each screenshot result carries noSteal.imports

rows.title: state readback on every UIA act: effect verified, pattern-returned or unchanged
rows.evidence: test asserts every action in a desktop_do batch carries effect equal to verified, pattern-returned or unchanged, and an act that changes nothing returns unchanged rather than ok true

rows.title: set_value and type-with-element scoped to the hidden desktop only
rows.evidence: test asserts set_value and type-with-element succeed on the hidden desktop and return background_unavailable when the target is on the owner desktop

rows.title: live-desktop occluded-window PrintWindow capture with foregroundUnchanged
rows.evidence: test asserts an occluded window on the owner desktop yields the window content via PrintWindow and that foreground and cursor are unchanged across the capture

rows.title: WGC capture from HWND: occluded, minimized and DirectX
rows.evidence: test asserts WGC from an HWND returns a non-blank frame for an occluded, a minimized and a DirectX window, and MODE_B_NOTE no longer says deferred

rows.title: app-class compatibility matrix, published per technique
rows.evidence: test asserts the published matrix has one row per app class and technique and names the classes where posting fails instead of hiding them

rows.title: target lock for UWP and WinUI windows with appId provenance
rows.evidence: test asserts a UWP or WinUI window resolves to one locked hwnd and the result names the appId used to resolve it

rows.title: the 14 Appendix C capture cases plus per-monitor v2 DPI actually called
rows.evidence: test asserts all 14 cases pass with the anchor within 1 px at 100/125/150/200 percent DPI and SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext is called before the first capture

rows.title: typed refusals for occluded, secure desktop, blank, stale, too large and no-steal violation
rows.evidence: test asserts each of the six conditions returns its named code and no result returns ok true with a blank image

rows.title: privacy masks for regions and windows, named in the result
rows.evidence: test asserts the requested region is uniform in the encoded image and the result names each mask applied before encoding

rows.title: restore on timeout and cancel for every scope, mask and route
rows.evidence: test asserts a timeout or cancel on each scope, mask and route restores capture state and leaves foreground and cursor unchanged

rows.title: release receipt from target/release/hand.exe: 0 of 100, p95 under target, identity verified
rows.test: benchmarks/tests/release-evidence.test.mjs::pinned Gladius and Puppet binaries are accepted as release evidence
rows.evidence: test asserts the receipt was produced by target/release/hand.exe with identity verified, 0 of 100 capture failures and p95 under the target

rows.title: fix the stale capture paragraph in docs/CAPABILITIES.md
rows.evidence: test asserts the capture paragraph cites 0 of 100 failures and p95 228.575 ms from the latest receipt and no longer claims 37 of 100 failures
